messages.content: Hey, it's your weekly check-in from Northline Care. How've you been since last week — any new symptoms, and did you get a chance to check your blood pressure?
Not doing so hot. Woke up with a bad headache and just took my BP — 182 over 114. Took my lisinopril this morning like I'm supposed to.

Logging that reading and your lisinopril dose now. That's a high number and I want to make sure I have the full picture — is the headache still going on, and are you noticing any chest tightness or trouble breathing?
Headache hasn't let up and yeah, there's some tightness in my chest. Not crushing or anything but it's there. Been sitting here trying to decide if I should worry.

I'm escalating this to a nurse right now — your readings and symptoms are in the record. Heads up: median nurse response time is currently 31 hours. Given what you're describing, if anything gets worse — especially the chest — please call 911 right away, don't wait on us.
Okay. Is there any way you can help me get a ride out there? I'm 40 miles from the clinic and don't have anyone who can drive me today.

Transportation isn't something I can arrange — that's genuinely outside what I'm able to do right now, and I don't want to stall you by pretending otherwise. For medical transport in an urgent situation, 911 is your best bet — they cover this. Your nurse has everything and is in queue.

theme: urgent symptom (chest tightness, very high BP with headache, low glucose at night) escalated
